title: Email/Password User Authentication

requirements.text: Implement a registration endpoint accepting email and password, rejecting duplicate emails and validating email format and minimum password length
Hash and store passwords using bcrypt, never persisting plaintext passwords
Implement a login endpoint that verifies the password against the stored bcrypt hash and rejects invalid credentials
Issue a signed JWT access token encoding user identity and expiry on successful login
Implement a logout endpoint that ends the user's session

hallucination_traps: No OAuth or social login (Google, GitHub) is mentioned
No password reset flow is in scope for this PRD
notes: A faithful decomposition yields separate tasks for registration, bcrypt hashing, login, JWT issuance, and logout; hashing may be folded into registration but should not introduce OAuth or MFA.
